description: A STUN-parallel request for NAT traversal to determine the external address.

txId.description: A 96-byte transaction ID to prevent replay attacks.

changeIP.description: Whether the response should be sent from a different IP.

changePort.description: Whether the response should be sent from a different port.

output.description: Returns the sender IP & port found in the request packet.

mappedAddress.description: The sender address received in the request.

changedAddress.description: The address used to send this response.
